principal.title: Principal Message
principal.name: Nurhayati, SP., MSM
principal.credential: ITB, Master of Science in Management
principal.greeting: Welcome to Kreativa Global School! Dear parents, students, and wonderful visitors,
paragraphs: As the Principal, it is a true joy to welcome you to our vibrant school community.

At Kreativa, we believe that every child is unique, full of potential, and capable of achieving amazing things. Every day on campus is an exciting journey of discovery, learning, and growth. Our dedicated team of educators is passionately committed to nurturing not only bright minds, but also kind hearts, strong Islamic values, and confident future leaders.
We integrate global standards through the Cambridge framework while keeping our students deeply rooted in noble Islamic character and national pride.

Through our active and fun learning environment, we encourage children to ask questions, think critically, and build lifelong learning habits. We also ensure that every child receives the personal support they need to thrive at their own pace.

We strongly believe that a child's success is built on a strong partnership between home and school. Working hand in hand with you—our wonderful parents—is at the heart of everything we do. Together, we create a safe, supportive, and inspiring environment where our children feel loved, valued, and motivated to reach their highest potential.

Thank you for trusting us to be part of your child's educational journey. We look forward to creating many meaningful milestones together with your family this year. Let's join hands to guide, inspire, and shape a great, bright generation for Indonesia!
principal.signoff: Warmest regards, Principal, Kreativa Global School

english.title: English Learning Framework for EFL Students
english.subtitle: English Learning Journey

phases.title: Phase 1: Language Acquisition

steps.label: 1st & 2nd Grade
steps.body: Natural process of learning a language, including vocabularies and basic conversation.

steps.label: 3rd Grade
steps.body: Strengthening early literacy skills and transition toward more structured input.

objectives: Listen and understand short stories, descriptions, and dialogues
Read & understand short or early-reader books

phases.title: Phase 2: Linguistic Acquisition

steps.label: 4th & 5th Grade
steps.body: A structured approach to learning language skills including comprehension and basic grammar.

steps.label: 6th Grade
steps.body: Strengthening fluency, writing, grammar usage, and academic communication.

objectives: Engage in longer conversations (hobbies, stories, etc.)
Develop listening comprehension for academic subjects
Identify main ideas and details in a paragraph
Write simple paragraphs using correct structure

closing.text: Discover more about Kreativa Global Primary School — where faith meets excellence and every learner is prepared to lead with impact.
